title: Stretch-length exponent in spatial networks
exact_target: Find sharper optimal network-length bounds under a stretch constraint and identify their divergence exponent as stretch approaches one.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 9700018 (AMR-096-0018). CC BY 4.0.

David Aldous and Tamar Lando, \emph{The stretch-length tradeoff in geometric networks: average case and worst case study}, Mathematical Proceedings of the Cambridge Philosophical Society 159 (2015), 125--145, Section 1, definitions and scaling question, pp. 1--3; Section 2, existence of limits.
